new_player.message: Welcome, adventurer! Find the treasure at the end of the road.

meta.notes: How the world starts: the game's own world (no World Type of its own). Players play in adventure mode on normal difficulty; when the world first starts the game rules are set: mobs do not break blocks, keep things on death. Each new player is welcomed by a message, once. Build your map in the game and bring the builds back as structures. Everything here lowers to plain data pack files.
